canonical_project: VueNow Edge Data Centre - Malihabad (Lucknow district)
notes: DCD (Dec 2024) reports VueNow inaugurated two new Edge data centers in Malihabad (a tehsil of Lucknow district) and Ambedkarnagar, led by the MoS for Excise & Prohibition with IT department officials; part of the 750-edge-DC network under the 2021 MoU. Capacity not disclosed; VueNow under ED investigation for the 'cloud particle' scam.
